newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down, volume up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed down by 1.19 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 587.31 from 594.40 on Monday.
Trade volume was 5.505 million dinars against 1.248 million dinars.
Tunisian Leasing Compagnie was down 15.04 dinars to 31.4 dinars. UBCI bank was down 1.66 dinar to 53.64 dinars. Retail stores Monopirx eased one dinar to 33.1 dinars.
Coca bottler SFBT won 3.44 dinars to 118.37 dinars. BNDT bank was up 0.83 dinar to 28.59 dinars. STB bank was up 0.68 dinar to 23.41 dinars.
